info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Operations Management API provides functionalities to adjust market allocations based on specific parameters. Through this API, users can modify the allocation settings for market operations identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include financial institutions and platforms managing trading operations, enabling them to optimize order allocations efficiently. This API supports seamless integration into existing systems, helping users maintain accurate and responsive market operation strategies.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to updates the allocation details for a specific order identified by its resource ID. Users can modify attributes such as quantity, status, and other relevant fields to reflect current allocation needs.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for updating the order allocation associated with the specified resource (RES-100045). It is designed to accept changes to various attributes of the order allocation, enabling efficient modifications in the system.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the order allocation has been updated.
